Abebook.description: Second printing of the Yale University Press paperback edition (Yale Paperbound Y-539) of Gordon Williams's study of Virgil's literary technique as a route to the meaning of the Aeneid; with bibliography and index. Trade softcover, cream wrappers with a line drawing of a Roman soldier to the front panel, protected by a clear plastic cover whose flaps fold inside the wrappers; issued without dust jacket. The wrappers are bright and clean beneath that cover, which has preserved them well, with one small brown spot to the lower front panel and a few dark specks to the spine; the spine is square and uncreased and the binding tight and unbroken, the book opening flat without strain. The edges of the text block are toned, with a darker stain to the upper outer corner of the leaves and a few small specks to the preliminary leaves; the text itself is clean and unmarked throughout, with no underlining or annotation. A very good copy.
